code='''def transform(grid):
    # Extend the diagonal trail of the non-background color that begins as a
    # two-cell down-right run, continuing it to the grid edge.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    coords={v:[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v and x!=bg] for v in counts if v!=bg}
    for color, pts in coords.items():
        pts.sort()
        # identify same-color diagonal trail of length >=2
        for r,c in pts:
            if (r+1,c+1) in pts:
                rr,cc=r+2,c+2
                while rr<len(g) and cc<len(g[0]):
                    g[rr][cc]=color
                    rr+=1;cc+=1
                return g
    return g
'''
